items.title: A global Microsoft 365 outage has hit millions – what happened and when will it be fixed?
items.desc: Problem affects businesses, government agencies and even tech firm’s own employees Microsoft scrambles to fix global outage affecting Teams and Outlook Microsoft outage – live updates Tell us: have you been affected by the Microsoft outage? Millions of people were unable to access their emails, Teams chats or meetings on Thursday night and Friday after a Microsoft 365 outage brought down services across the globe. The outage has lasted for more than 21 hours, with meaningful signs of recovery visible beginning shortly before midday GMT on Friday. It affected businesses, government agencies and even Microsoft employees all over the world. Those reporting issues have included the US House of Representatives, an Australian spy agency, airlines in India, European government agencies, and police services, ambulances and hospitals in the UK. items.title: Duran Duran drummer Roger Taylor leaves band due to tinnitus
items.desc: ‘I must now listen to my body and my doctors’, says Taylor, who was one of the earliest members of the new wave hit-makers The drummer for Duran Duran, Roger Taylor, is to step down from the band due to worsening tinnitus. In a statement, Taylor said: “This is one of the hardest decisions I’ve ever had to make. Playing drums in this band has been the joy of my life, and I’ll never be able to properly thank the fans for the love they’ve shown us over the years. But the truth is that my tinnitus has been getting steadily worse, and I’ve reached the point where I must now listen to my body and my doctors.” Continue reading...
